messages:
Jordan (Sales): Heads up — NimbusBank sent a CAIQ + a 12-page custom security questionnaire. They want completed answers + evidentiary artifacts by 2026-03-28 EOD. POC scheduled Wed 3/30. Need owner for answers and list of deliverables. Link: https://files.company/nimbus/CAIQ.pdf

Anya (AE): Do answers change based on Dedicated vs Hosted? They specifically asked about data residency & encryption at rest vs in transit.

Mike (Solutions): POC will run on a hosted demo for now. If they buy Dedicated it'll change some answers (customer-managed KMS). I can produce SAML metadata and demo infra diagram.

Lina (Security): I can own the questionnaire but need artifacts. Please attach: 1) SAML IdP/SP metadata (XML), 2) KMS key policy + attestations (pdf), 3) SOC 2 summary + last report date, 4) network diagram showing VPC/subnet flow, 5) CAIQ-spreadsheet mapping. Also which model variants will be used in the POC? Any PHI/PCI in sample data?

Jordan (Sales): No PHI/PCI in initial POC. They will test with redacted customer messages. Timeline is tight — procurement gave 3 business days.

security-bot: New intake ticket created: RWI-3456. Uploaded CAIQ.pdf and custom_qs.xlsx to ticket. https://rwi.tickets/RWI-3456

Anya (AE): @Lina can we answer "key rotation frequency" and "who holds KMS admin"? They put that as a gating item for legal.

Mike (Solutions): I can drop `saml_metadata.xml` into the ticket + a short architecture diagram (png). For Dedicated answers, we need to notify infra for KMS policies.

Sam (Eng Infra): I'm Sam, I'll provide KMS owner contact and rotate schedule. Assigning myself to help with KMS artifacts. ETA 24h.

Lina (Security): Good — @Sam please attach the key policy doc + proof of rotation logs (last 6 months). @Mike attach the demo environment subnet diagram and the `saml_metadata.xml`. Jordan, can you confirm the CAIQ spreadsheet will be editable? Prefer a mapped sheet with control ID -> answer -> evidence link.

Jordan (Sales): I'll upload an editable Google sheet and add the procurement contacts. Uploading now.

Mike (Solutions): Quick snippet to fetch demo metadata if helpful: `curl -s https://demo.redwood.example/saml/metadata > saml_metadata.xml`

Lina (Security): I'll take ownership of completing answers and will post a first pass in 48h. If legal requires signed attestation we'll escalate to compliance. Marking thread: owner=Lina (Security). RWI-3456 will be the single source of truth.

Jordan (Sales): Massive thanks team :thumbsup:
